videos.title: My Cat From Hell
videos.description: 911, My Cat's Holding Me Hostage! Jackson travels to Portland to help Lee and Teresa, who called 911 on their cat Lux. After their son Jesse pulled on Lux's tail, he got clawed.

videos.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
videos.description: Robert helps out with a health check for the zoo's unusual-looking alligator snapping turtles. Terri and Bindi welcome seven new Lemurs from the US.

videos.title: Lone Star Law
videos.description: In Calhoun County, Ben and Chelsea Bailey are out patrolling shrimp boats when one makes a run for it. Meanwhile, another warden makes some new furry friends.

videos.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
videos.description: Dr. Jeff and the team head to a remote town offering low-cost care to pets. Plus, Dr. Petra performs life-saving surgery on a Basset Hound that was hit by a car.

videos.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
videos.description: Shelter volunteers drive from Kansas hoping the team can save a tiny rescue dog. Plus, Dr. Jeff's cousin asks for the vets to visit Tennessee to provide free care.

videos.description: Home Is Where The Dog Is. One of Earl's favourite senior dogs has a chance at finding a forever home. Plus, Tia heads to a shelter in Louisiana to help with a hound they've taken in.

videos.description: Tania and Maria create a retirement centre for senior dogs at one of the warehouses. Meanwhile, Lizzy rescues a dog whose skin is in an awful condition.

videos.title: My Cat From Hell
videos.description: Roadtrip Rescue. The Cat Daddy takes the show on the road! In order save the lives of 50 kittens from LA shelters, he drives them back to his roots in Boulder, CO.

videos.title: My Cat From Hell
videos.description: Jackson deals with a young man with a genuine cat phobia, and he returns to Colorado to keep his favourite kitten from the kitten rescue road trip in her adoptive home.

videos.title: Treehouse Masters
videos.description: A Treehouse Fit For A Viking. Pete takes on his first international build in Norway. Working with local builder, Frode, the 24 ft high retreat gives stunning views of a nearby lake.

videos.title: Saved By The Barn
videos.description: Dan races to North Carolina to rescue a group of pigs from horrific living conditions. Plus, the organisation's new sign is put on display.

videos.title: How Do Animals Do That?
videos.description: Experts reveal how blind bats avoid collision. Do mice really like cheese? What makes manatees' farts so special? And, why are slugs so slimy.

videos.title: How Do Animals Do That?
videos.description: Experts examine how humpback whales leap so far out of water. Why do dogs tilt their heads? Why do animals swarm? How do spiders shed their skin.

videos.description: Forrest combs the Florida Everglades for the black panther, which has never been seen in the US. Discoveries in the area suggest it may be more than a rumour.

videos.description: Where There's Water There's A Way. As the siblings race to finish their water system, Billy gets news that shakes the Wolfpack. Bear goes hunting and reflects on a big life decision.
